claim: Patchline ships a dependency-aware sequencing planner ordering cross-service migrations with two-phase safety. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the dependency-aware sequencing claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make dependency-aware-sequencing-gate`.
